principles.description: Every project begins with what's already known: analytics, support tickets, prior research, the team's own intuitions. The design problem isn't visible until I've sat with the evidence.
principles.label: Discovery

principles.description: Strategy and shipped pixels are the same conversation. Earning trust to do bigger work means landing the smaller version cleanly first: a single screen, a single flow, a single decision that holds up in production.
principles.label: Method

principles.description: A great interaction isn't the wireframe; it's the handful of micro-decisions made between Figma and the engineer's pull request. Most of the value lives in the last 10%.
principles.label: Craft

principles.description: Design that scales is design that's traceable. Every recurring decision deserves a written rationale, not because anyone will read it, but because the act of writing it down is what makes it sturdy.
principles.label: Systems
